title: Rob Reinhardt's recent visit to "Atlanta" (apparently Atlantis)

tellings.quote: dear friend Rob Reinhardt that recently visited Atlanta, who

plain: The researcher Randall Carlson mentions on the show that a dear friend of his, a man named Rob Reinhardt, recently visited "Atlanta", which from the context seems to mean Atlantis, the lost island of Plato's story. Carlson brings it up in passing and says nothing more about where the place is or what Reinhardt found there.
